definitionZh: caret-shape CSS属性设置了插入caret的形状,即可编辑元素中出现的可见标记,以表示下一个字符将插入或删除的地方.
sourceDefinition: The caret-shape CSS property sets the shape of the insertion caret, the visible marker that appears in editable elements to indicate where the next character will be inserted or deleted.
